installer-gui-script.title: PGPM

choice.title: GnuPG: get GPG Suite 2023.3 (required)
choice.description: PGPM uses GnuPG for all encryption and for hardware keys. Setup downloads GPG Suite from gpgtools.org (an internet connection is needed), checks the download, and opens its installer: finish it to use PGPM.

choice.title: GnuPG is already installed
choice.description: PGPM will use the GnuPG that is already on this Mac.

choice.title: Create a desktop icon
choice.description: A PGPM icon on your desktop.
